name: Beginner Full Body Foundation
description: A full-body strength and conditioning routine designed for absolute beginners to establish shoulder stability, core strength, and basic lower body mechanics.
frequency: 3 days per week (e.g., Monday, Wednesday, Friday)
warmup: 5-10 mins light cardio (jumping jacks, high knees)
Shoulder rolls & arm circles (15 reps each direction)
Scapular shrugs on floor (2 sets of 10 reps)

exercises.coaching_note: Focus on hips back, knees in line with toes, and keeping chest proud.
Touch lower chest to edge of box. Keep core completely stiff.
Pull chest to bar. Squeeze glutes and retract shoulder blades.
Keep back close to the bench. Lock elbows out at the top.
Avoid sagging. Actively push floor away and tuck tailbone.
Build strong grip and active shoulders.

cooldown: Chest stretch against wall (30 secs per side)
Quad stretch standing (30 secs per leg)

name: Intermediate Upper/Lower Split
description: A 4-day split routine focusing on building vertical and horizontal pushing/pulling strength, solid core compression, and foundational single-leg power.
warmup: Band pull-aparts & shoulder dislocates (15 reps each)
Wrist prep and plank lean warmups

exercises.coaching_note: Strict reps only. Full dead hang to chest-to-bar height.
Lean slightly forward to engage chest. Go to at least 90-degree bend.
Form tripod with head and hands. Tuck elbows.
Keep arms fully locked. Push bar down to hips.
Keep supporting heel flat on ground. Use light hand assistance.
Depress shoulders and lock arms completely straight.

name: Advanced Skill & Strength Plan
description: An intense routine designed for seasoned athletes working to master elite bodyweight skills like the planche, front lever, muscle-up, and handstand push-up.
warmup: 10 mins thorough joint and tissue prep

exercises.coaching_note: Explosive pull-up. Focus on rapid transition and bar dip.
Perfect arm lockout. Protract scapula and lean forward.
Flatten lower back completely. Keep thighs perpendicular.
Tripod head touch. Avoid banana spine arching.
Deep single-leg squats under strict eccentric control.
Press hands flat into floor. Lift hips and heels up.
